# Getting In: VA, ID.me and Social Security from abroad

> A free guide for veterans, widows and widowers outside the US: signing in to VA.gov with ID.me, what goes wrong and the way through, claims on paper with no login, spotting scammers, and who to call.

Checked against VA, ID.me, Login.gov and Social Security pages on 2026-10-20. Free. Made by Hongdam for Chiang Mai Visa Desk.

- Before you start (documents, phone, email)
- Which sign-in works from abroad (ID.me, Login.gov, CLEAR)

- When a veteran has died
- No login: post, fax and phone (addresses)
- Phone lines from abroad
